name: Best Paw Forward
source:
Best Paw Forward sees you as a 1st year veterinary student, going through your courses and meeting new friends!

You'll be able to experience the first three weeks of class at vet school, learn some basics of veterinary medicine from Dr. McDee, and meet fellow classmates, Freddie, Kat, and Skye.

[edited from [url=https://ruixiaobai.itch.io/best-paw-forward]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《Best Paw Forward》中，你将扮演兽医专业一年级学生，上课学习，结识新朋友！

体验兽医学校开学后的前三周，向麦迪博士学习一些兽医学基础知识，并认识弗雷迪、凯特和斯凯等同学。

[编辑自[url=https://ruixiaobai.itch.io/best-paw-forward]itch.io[/url]]
